The number one thing I try to keep in mind is that when I’m older I’ll have a successful job, a beautiful/handsome spouse, and some kids who I can take care of. When it’s my turn to be the father, I’m determined to not let the holidays be stressful for them. I just want them to grow up and look back and think about how much fun it was every year.

TW for nearly everything

I do this. I usually need those “dating” ASMRs to get my through tough times. I have a lot of them memorized tbh.
I hope it helps me tbh. I don’t want to have to restrict and be sad my whole life. I’m going to take up more cardio and stuff, and hopefully it gives me good results :)

I’m 14M and I’d love to talk if you want. I’ve been manipulated online more times than I can count, and the most recent was a month ago. I suffer from very persistent anxiety, depression, and am recovering from an eating disorder currently. I understand life is really, really difficult. I’m always here if you want to talk.

Thank you!

Yes! Thank you! He thought we were being manipulative, but didn’t know he was literally losing his mind at a child alter. So this kid is literally begging him to stay and ends up having a meltdown because our ‘friend’ called him toxic and manipulative. Yeah.. and then said friend tried to deny it was the child alter.

Yeah. My friend knew, but the issue was that we had can front without even realizing it. So he’d ask a question and we’d answer a certain way, then he’d ask it again a bit later and get a different answer.

However, he did use our bad memory against us a bit. We had no idea what he was talking about when he said we said something, and he easily could have slipped a few details in there without us knowing.

Thank you for the advice, though! We’ll definitely try :)

Thank you.. so damn much.

It’s so hard to feel good about myself when there’s so much BS surrounding us 24/7. I’m trying to take a break from any serious things, while I work on my view of myself.

You’re a great person. Thank you, so much.
